A fee of $240 will be assessed by mail for all follow-up inspections. If repeated red item violations are observed at a follow-up inspection, an additional follow-up inspection will be required. Notes: - At the time of the inspection, facility's walk-in cooler was non-functional and the only prep top cooler was removed. Facility's menu is comprised of made-to-order items. Facility also sells pre-packaged salads, parfaits, chips, pretzels, and cheese sauce. Facility may only sell pre-packaged items until a commercial grade prep top cooler is installed and is holding at 41F or below. Stop all made to order food preparation immediately. Compliance Schedule OBSERVATIONS AND CORRECTIVE ACTIONS You must complete the following items by the due date listed below . Your inspector will do a compliance inspection . Complete ByItem Number 10/16/2026 4000 Food and non-food surfaces properly used and constructed; cleanable. 4000 Observed the following: - Walk -in cooler: empty, broken, ambient 70F. - 2 door prep top cooler: broken, removed. Per PIC, the unit is in repair. Repair or replace the non-functioning refrigeration unit. If replaced, unit must be commercial and equal or greater capacity. Unit must cold hold at 41ºF or below. Your permit to operate and plan review approval is based on amount of refrigeration. Due to broken essential equipment, all made to order items pulled from menu. *A compliance order has been issued to stop selling made to order food and reinstall a 2-door prep top cooler and ensure it is holding at 41F or below by 10/16/2026. Failure to so will result in a non-compliance fee of $240. Contact your inspector with questions or if you need more time to complete these items.
